source_known_rule_lost.comp: one of exactly 12 compartment buckets (the `comps` key). Same shape as proc: the source ontology survives, the coarsening rule does not

source_not_identified.tss: stored as a STRING; the same promoter as ens_tss picked per-TRANSCRIPT rather than at the gene boundary (6.65% exact, median offset 75 bp, corr 0.9998). The transcript set that defines the pick -- MANE, canonical, refGene, CAGE -- is not recorded
source_not_identified.npath: a pathway count. Not GO process count (corr 0.02) and not membership in the `pathways` key (exact 0.37), so the pathway database used is not recorded
source_not_identified.path: a single Reactome-style pathway name with a trailing space; the release is not recorded
source_not_identified.enh: an enhancer count; the catalogue is not recorded
source_not_identified.ndis: a disease count; the database is not recorded

cell_complete.json NOW HAS A PRODUCER for 7 of the 8 fields it
attempts, each checked against the surviving copy rather than asserted. 17% of all
per-gene module-reads are now backed by a named source that was fetched and verified;
another 30% have a URL recorded and need one more download.
Q3 FAILS ON cpg, and the gate stands. The diagnosis is sharper than
the verdict: the CpG track is right and the query point is the file's own tss rather
than the Ensembl gene boundary, but no declared rule reaches 0.90 and none
of the swept ones was adopted. A near-miss is exactly where loosening a threshold
turns an unverified column into a verified-looking one, so it is left failing.
AND 6% CANNOT BE REBUILT AT ALL. Those are labels this project
invented -- conf, dark, ess_prob, flag, master, ti -- whose rules are lost. A producer
that regenerated them from a guessed rule would be worse than one that says so,
because the guess would look identical in the file and differ in every value.
A further 13% is real data whose source this file never named
(enh, ndis, npath, path, tss) and 7% keeps its ontology but lost the
coarsening rule (comp, proc). Neither is invented and neither is
reproducible; they are the middle of the distribution and were the easiest to overstate.
